title: API Handoff Audit
summary: Check an API repository before a teammate inherits it.
user: Small engineering teams handing a shared API workflow to a new contributor.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that finds missing variables and setup gaps, runs named smoke requests against explicit local or staging targets, and writes a redacted handoff report.
constraints: Never upload request bodies or secrets by default.
Support only explicit local or staging endpoints in v1.
